rule.en: Never answer a direction question from intuition. Write the chain explicitly (P↑ → … → ?). For identities, substitute signs and solve algebraically. Translate every exchange-rate statement into 'stronger or weaker currency?' before anything else. Trade surplus (X − M > 0) = net capital OUTflow.
rule.kr: 방향 문제는 직관으로 답하지 않는다. 연쇄를 끝까지 적고(P↑ → … → ?), 항등식은 부호를 대입해 대수로 푼다. 환율은 무조건 '자국통화 강세/약세'로 먼저 번역. 무역흑자(X − M > 0) = 순자본 유출.

evidence: M3 official Q16 (lower P → real FX depreciates)
M3 official Q20 (weak currency raises AD)

name.en: Which curve? (SRAS vs LRAS, AD vs AS, firm vs market)
name.kr: 어느 곡선? (SRAS vs LRAS, AD vs AS, 기업 vs 시장)

rule.en: Cost/price factors (wages, input prices, taxes, subsidies, expectations, FX) move SRAS only; resource/technology factors (labor, capital, productivity) move BOTH. To diagnose a shock from data: output and prices same direction → demand; opposite → supply. Stagflation is never an AD story.
rule.kr: 비용·가격 요인(임금·투입가격·세금·보조금·기대·환율)은 SRAS만, 자원·기술 요인(노동·자본·생산성)은 둘 다. 데이터로 충격 진단: 산출과 물가가 같은 방향 → 수요, 반대 → 공급. 스태그플레이션은 절대 AD 이야기가 아님.

evidence: M3 official Q19 (indexed wages → steeper SRAS)
M3 official Q21 (LRAS left = productivity, not wages)

rule.en: Before choosing, re-read the stem's last line: which stage, which unit, which period, average or marginal, price or quantity? Value added at a step = receipts − ALL purchased inputs; the final price is the whole chain's contribution, not the last step's.
rule.kr: 답 고르기 전에 문제의 마지막 줄을 다시 읽는다: 어느 단계·단위·기간, 평균인지 한계인지, 가격인지 수량인지. 단계별 부가가치 = 매출 − 구입 투입 전부; 최종가격은 체인 전체 기여분이지 마지막 단계가 아님.

evidence: M3 official Q5 (value added of final step = 3,000, not 5,000)

rule.en: 'Annual' over a multi-year span means geometric: (end/start)^(1/n) − 1, never (total %)/n. Same rule as annualized returns in Quant Methods. Nominal = real × inflation is multiplicative, not additive.
rule.kr: 다년간의 '연간' 성장률은 기하평균: (끝/시작)^(1/n) − 1. 총변화율 ÷ n은 오답. QM 연율화 수익률과 같은 규칙. 명목 = 실질 × 물가도 곱셈이지 덧셈이 아님.

evidence: M3 official Q9 (deflator 190 → 212.8 over 2 years = 5.8%/yr, not 6%)

name.kr: 정의의 한 단어 함정 · 범위 공백

rule.en: For 'best describes' stems, find the single wrong word in each distractor (maximum vs. natural, verifiable, resalable). Natural output is NOT the maximum — it has a modest, stable pool of unemployed. If a topic feels unfamiliar (personal income chain), flag it as a note gap rather than guessing.
rule.kr: 'best describes' 문제는 각 오답 선지에서 틀린 단어 하나를 찾는다(maximum vs natural, verifiable, resalable). 자연산출은 '최대'가 아니라 소규모 안정적 실업 풀이 있는 수준. 낯선 주제(개인소득 체인)는 찍지 말고 노트 공백으로 표시.

evidence: M3 official Q12 (personal income chain — note gap, now §1b)

official_misses.note: Chose the final sale price (5,000) instead of value added at the last step (3,000).
Divided the 2-year change by 2 (6%) instead of annualizing geometrically (5.8%).
Personal income chain was not in the notes — knowledge gap, now covered in §1b.
Flipped the identity: higher saving with I, Y fixed must raise net exports (capital outflow), not lower them.
Lower price level → real exchange rate DEPRECIATES → net exports rise. Chose appreciation.
Natural level of output is not the maximum obtainable; it has a modest stable pool of unemployed.
Indexed wages remove the margin incentive → SRAS steeper, not unchanged.
A weak currency RAISES AD (exports cheaper); it cannot be a cause of an AD decrease.
LRAS shifts only with resource/technology factors (productivity); nominal wages move SRAS only.
Stagflation comes from an SRAS shift, so it is the one NOT caused by AD.
